newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady but consumer demand low.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady but consumer demand low.

text.p: Indian sugar prices held steady in a narrow trading range on Friday, dealers said.
Consumer and retail demand fell but restricted arrivals kept the market at around previous levels.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,278/1,320 rupees per quintal while M-30 was steady at 1,310/1,368 rupees. Sugar mill delivery however slid by five rupees at 1,210/1,220 rupees per quintal amid sluggish outstation buying at mill level.
